test.fullName: Nesting depth — 32-level document limit rejects a 32-level ExpressionAttributeValue with ValidationException

splits.behaviour: UpdateItem carrying a 32-level ExpressionAttributeValue. 32 is the documented limit, so this is a boundary disagreement rather than a violation: strict regions reject it in validation, the rest accept the value and go on to evaluate the condition. Probed against a key that is never written, so the condition is false everywhere and a ConditionalCheckFailedException is proof the value was accepted rather than a sign of differing regional state. The test lives in tests/tier3/limits/, which sets no assertion-strictness convention, and its regex matches both wordings: it does not enforce which side a region is on, so this row is the only place the exact answers are pinned.

splits.behaviour: Scan with Segment equal to TotalSegments: the 2026-06 validation-framework rollout reaching Scan's parameter checks. New-cohort regions answer the out-of-range sentence alone; old-cohort regions append ': Segment: 5 is not less than TotalSegments: 5'. eu-central-1 and us-west-1 crossed before the 2026-09-19 sweep; ap-northeast-2 and the pinned eu-west-2 crossed between that sweep and the 2026-09-26 one (eu-west-2 still gave the old wording on the 2026-09-20 conformance run), so the pinned answer is now the new wording. The other 29 answering regions give the old wording.
